headline: Geopolitical tensions spike VIX; Fed rate hike odds rising amid inflation persistence

eventsToday.event: US-Iran military exchange; oil prices jump
Semiconductor sector selloff led by SK Hynix

bullets.title: Iran tensions spike equity selling, VIX jumps
bullets.body: US-Iran military exchange drove broad risk-off; VIX +14.17% to 17.16 despite measured level.

bullets.title: Fed pivoting toward July rate hike probability
bullets.body: CNBC reports odds rising; Warsh/Williams signal hawkish tilt amid 4.3% CPI, 3.4% Core PCE.

bullets.title: Semiconductor bloodbath: SK Hynix -15%, semis lead
bullets.body: SK Hynix collapse dragged NVDA (-3.52%), INTC (-6.12%); chip cycle concerns resurface.

bullets.title: Tech weakness: QQQ -1.90% vs SPY -0.77%
bullets.body: Nasdaq underperformance; growth names NVDA, TSLA, META sold; MSFT (+1.53%) sole mega-cap strength.

bullets.title: 10Y yield jumps 88bp; yield curve steepens
bullets.body: 10Y at 4.61%; 2Y-10Y spread widening on Fed hike expectations; puts pressure on growth valuations.

bullets.title: Quantum computing collapse: IONQ -9.29% today
bullets.body: IONQ leads declines; speculative tech sectors hit hardest in risk-off environment.

bullets.title: Labor market stable; 4.2% unemployment supports hike
bullets.body: June jobless rate 4.2%, payrolls 159M+; no recession signals supporting Fed confidence on rates.

watchlistMovers.blurb: Quantum play crushed in tech selloff.
Semiconductor weakness amid memory chip fears.
Chip sector contagion from SK Hynix collapse.
